## Overview

**Movie Recommendation System** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Content-based movie recommender—PDS 2020–2021, Prof. Chan Sophal.

## Background & Motivation

**Movie Recommendation System** — PDS 2020–2021, ITC Data Science (3rd year). Lecturer **Prof. Chan Sophal**. Six-member group.

Streaming and rental platforms overwhelm users with choice; content-based recommendations improve discovery when collaborative data is sparse.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

**From *Project Guideline: Movie Recommendation System*:**

- **Approach:** **Content-based filtering**
- **Inputs:** Movie name, ratings, overview, cast/star, gross, votes, similar-user tastes
- **Steps:** (1) Scrape data (2) Preprocess (3) Build similarity (4) Recommend top-N titles (5) Evaluate relevance (6) Document system

## Data Collection & Preparation

Scraped movie metadata and rating features (see `Movie_Recommendation_System` subfolder).

## Methodology & Analysis

Content feature vectors; cosine/pearson similarity; top-N recommendations per user profile.

## Model Evaluation

Qualitative and metric-based checks on recommendation relevance.

## Results & Key Learnings

Working recommender prototype and group report for PDS 2020–2021.
